A dramatic scene in the sky. In the upper center, Jesus descends from heaven surrounded by bright golden light and angels, one of whom is blowing a large trumpet. Below, clouds separate the heavenly scene from the earth. People are shown rising upward from the earth toward the clouds to meet Jesus—some appearing in glowing white robes rising from graves (the dead in Christ), and others rising alongside them (the living believers). Clean flat textbook illustration, respectful and awe-inspiring, white background.

A wide illustration showing the separation of the sheep and the goats. In the center sits Jesus on a glorious throne as King. On His right side (the viewer's left), happy people are being welcomed by angels, and a small inset scene shows them feeding a beggar and visiting a sick person. On His left side (the viewer's right), distressed people are being turned away into a fiery background, with an inset showing them ignoring a hungry person. Clean flat textbook style, distinct colors for contrast, white background.
